instruction.text: Select the two words that form this contraction.

hint.text: A contraction is a word made by shortening and combining two words. The apostrophe is used to show where letters are missing.

instruction.text: Read the sentence and write the long form of the contraction in the gap.

atoms.a: I couldn’t finish it, it was disgusting!
atoms.b: I ((could_not)) finish it, it was disgusting!

atoms.a: I haven’t had any time off work this year.
atoms.b: I ((have_not)) had any time off work this year.

atoms.a: She’d rather be playing football right now.
atoms.b: ((She_would)) rather be playing football right now.
